# Low-credit transaction fixture

This disposable loopback-only project invokes the product's real settlement and notice mutation handlers and the low-credit message helper. The scheduled notice action is inert; tests explicitly invoke the real notice action helper. The funding helper uses a synthetic HTTP response. Its transactional email table is a test double, not Resend: it never sends email or contacts a provider. The fixture passes a synthetic verified profile and response balance through settlement. Product payments remain off. It cannot prove the Autumn read, the actual Resend component, delivery, or production environment configuration.

Start a cached `convex-local-backend` with a fresh database and storage in this directory, interface `127.0.0.1`, cloud port `3480`, site port `3481`, `--disable-beacon`, and no `SENTRY_DSN`. Use a disposable instance name and instance secret, then derive its local admin key with the binary's `keygen admin-key` command. These are fixture credentials only. Do not connect this fixture to a shared or remote deployment.

With that backend running, in this directory run `CI=1 E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3480 CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_ADMIN_KEY=<local-key> bunx convex dev --once --typecheck disable --codegen disable`. Then from the repository root run `LOW_CREDIT_FIXTURE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3480 E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 bun test packages/tests/low-credit-email-integration.test.ts`. The test refuses other ports or hosts and skips when the URL is absent. Stop only the backend process you started.

To test the backend-side E2E gate, set `E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1` in this local Convex deployment with `convex env set` using the same loopback URL and local key. Then add `LOW_CREDIT_BACKEND_E2E=1` to the test command. The ordinary fixture cases require the backend flag unset or set to `0`. This flag does not propagate automatically from the test runner.
